vuln.name: HTTPS connection with weak key length
vuln.description: The key length for HTTPS connections is lower than the recommended 128 bits.
vuln.impact: The connection may be intercepted and possibly decrypted by a third party.
vuln.recommendation: The key length should be at least 128 bits.

reference.title: Testing for Weak SSL/TSL Ciphers, Insufficient Transport Layer Protection
